description: On the table in front of you are an open black case, a small plush dog, a white rubber duck, and a gray oval case. The right hand picks up the plush dog and places it into the open black case, then lifts the rubber duck and sets it inside as well; next the right hand moves the gray oval case into the black case, and then both hands bring the lid down to close the black case, with the case becoming a two-hand object as it shuts.
